Market today: The market's mood is cautious, driven by rising oil prices due to escalating Middle East tensions. This could be a drag on the broader economy and your tech-heavy portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL is down a massive -54.14% and flagged "SELL," demanding immediate attention. SPAL, a new leveraged position, is also down -60.95% and highly volatile. SMH and QQQI are both on "TRIM" with losses of -14.29% and -4.56% respectively. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on oil price movements and any further geopolitical developments. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) for continued volatility.

Bottom line: Your leveraged positions are bleeding, and oil is a wildcard; focus on risk management and reducing high-risk exposure.
plays: Given the "SELL" status and -54.14% loss, seriously consider reducing or exiting your SOXL leveraged position. It's a significant drag.
Trim your SMH position as indicated by the scanner, respecting the 540 stop. This reduces your chip sector exposure.
Consider a new buy in XLE (Energy ETF) at 58.6-58.54, stop 58.33. This aligns with strong energy sector headlines and a scanner "BUY" signal.
